title: Blue Note dates with Brew Moore and J.J. Johnson
summary: Alfred Lion records the Machito group; discussion of the 'I'll Remember April' session.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: At the time you and Brew were playing with Machito, did that record date you did for Blue Note come about with you and Brew and J.J.?

Yeah... Well, I told Alfred that I was doing a date with that particular band. So he sounded me whether I'd want to do a date for Blue Note with that band. Shit, I said, 'Why not? Let's see what we can get going.' And I made two or three albums with Blue Note.
I know afterwards you made one with Tal Farlow, I think.
Yeah. 'Jarm', that was on that album. And we made a thing with Kenny Drew. Is that the one...?
Well, Kenny Drew was on the Brew Moore with J.J. thing, because he was featured on 'I'll Remember April.' That was his feature.
But that was an excellent session, and it's really been one of those kind of lost sessions.
It's never really been reissued on 12-inch LP as far as I know, at least not here. I've got the 78's. But it's one that I felt was really an exceptionally good date.
Everybody played so well on it.
Yeah, and that 78 session really. Because it never became an album, I don't think.
Some of the later ones did, as 10-inch LP's and the like.

I think most of it was on an album. I think I got some of it, come to think of it. But man, I don't know what my record library is. I've got to straighten it out. That's why I had them shelves put up there.
Then you can get at it and know what you have.
That way I know what I got. Because every time, if somebody brings a record, I just put it with the rest of the records, you know. So I don't know where what is.
